quote.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

bio: Zion Creed writes gospel folk worship for the quiet moments and the big ones: songs of surrender, grace and hope, sung in both Afrikaans and English.

From the prayer of “U wil, my wil” and “Ek wil na U luister” to the praise of “Lion of Judah” and “Jesus You Are Holy”, every song points back to the same place: a God who listens, forgives and leads.
The catalogue keeps growing, and every release has its own artwork. Tap a cover below to listen on your favourite platform.

pillars.title: Surrender
pillars.text: Songs of prayer and trust, giving the day back to God.

pillars.title: Grace
pillars.text: Hope for every road, from “Keep Praying” to “Stronger Than the Battle”.

pillars.title: Praise
pillars.text: Songs that lift Jesus up, from “Lion of Judah” to “Jesus You Are Holy”.

pillars.title: Two languages
pillars.text: Written in Afrikaans and English, so more people can sing along.
